name: One More Week
source:
Follow the story of a first year university student as they move into their first accommodation and attend their first week at university, all while trying to overcome their anxieties and become an independent adult. 

You've been invited to a big party, everyone is going to be there. Part of you wants to go, the other part is screaming at you that this is a terrible idea. You're going to have to choose which part you're going to listen to, and whether or not you work through your troubles and take life one week at a time, or give into your anxieties.

[From [url=https://nostalgia-studios.itch.io/one-more-week]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
讲述一名大学一年级学生搬进第一个宿舍并参加大学第一周的故事，同时努力克服焦虑并成为一个独立的成年人。

你被邀请参加一个大型聚会，每个人都会参加。你的一部分想要离开，另一部分则对你尖叫，说这是一个糟糕的主意。你必须选择你要听哪一部分，以及你是否要解决你的麻烦并一次过一周的生活，或者屈服于你的焦虑。

[来自[url=https://nostalgia-studios.itch.io/one-more-week]itch.io[/url]]
